lines.text: All Israel from Dan to Beersheba assembled as one man before the LORD at Mizpah with 400,000 swordsmen.
Benjamin refused to hand over the wicked men of Gibeah and mobilized 26,000 swordsmen, plus 700 select men of Gibeah.
Israel went up to Shiloh and asked God who should go first, and the LORD said Judah.
Israel set an ambush around Gibeah and arrayed at Gilgal, and the LORD defeated Benjamin, killing 25,100 swordsmen.
Six hundred Benjamite men fled to the rock of Rimmon and stayed four months, and Israel burned the cities.
